summary: This report requests that City Council approves the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located at 116 Briar Hill Ave. The application indicates the reasons for removal are to construct a new dwelling and driveway on a severed lot. The subject tree is a Freeman maple (Acer x freemanii), measuring 23 cm in diameter. The City Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as a landscape plan was not satisfactory to the ward councillor.
decided: City Council on October 2 and 3, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located on the road allowance fronting 116 Briar Hill Avenue.

motions.desc: Majority required - NY8.34 - adopt the item
